description: Defines iterator classes and proxies for iterating over a map of string keys to Value objects, including mutable and immutable variants, within the 'base' namespace.

classes.name: dict_iterator
classes.description: Mutable iterator over DictStorage, abstracts unique_ptr and provides bidirectional iteration.

classes.name: const_dict_iterator
classes.description: Immutable iterator over DictStorage, provides read-only bidirectional iteration.

classes.name: dict_iterator_proxy
classes.description: Wrapper for begin/end methods, provides mutable iteration over DictStorage.

classes.name: const_dict_iterator_proxy
classes.description: Wrapper for begin/end methods, provides read-only iteration over DictStorage.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Dereferences iterator to access current element.

methods.name: operator->
methods.description: Provides pointer-like access to current element.
